announcements.summary: Amber Enterprises India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform the exchange that the timeline for completion of the second tranche of investment in MoMagic Wireless Private Limited by IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited, a material subsidiary of the Company, has been further extended to 30th November 2026, or such other date as may be mutually agreed upon by the parties to the Definitive Transaction Agreements.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, we wish to update the exchange on the Scheme of Amalgamation of AmberPR Technoplast India Private Limited with and into the Company. In context of hearing held on 25th September 2026, the Company has received an order dated 25th September 2026 received on 1st October 2026, passed by Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, in CP(CAA) No. 18/Chd/Pb/2026 connected with CA(CAA) No. 11/Chd/Pb/2026.
